title: Week 1 Worklog
content:
Period: 05/10/2026 → 09/10/2026
Topic: AWS Fundamentals, IAM & VPC
Status: Planned
Week 1 Objectives: Understand AWS Free Tier, credit strategy and cost management Practice AWS Budgets and AWS Support Understand IAM (User, Group, Policy, Role) and basic VPC architecture Tasks to be carried out this week: Day Morning (09:00–12:00) Afternoon (13:30–17:00) Start Date Completion Date Reference Material Mon AWS Free Tier & Credit: Free vs Paid Plan, strategy to get full $200 credit, 5 credit tasks Free Tier & Cost Optimization: credit killers to avoid, sample architectures, cost monitoring, learning roadmap 05/10/2026 05/10/2026 https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/ Tue AWS Budgets: create Cost, Usage, RI and Savings Plans budgets Cost Management & Cleanup: practice budgets, review Cost/Usage, clean up resources 06/10/2026 06/10/2026 https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/ Wed AWS Support Plans; IAM: introduction, create IAM Group and User IAM: create Role, Switch Role, cleanup. Practice User → Group → Policy → Role → Permission 07/10/2026 07/10/2026 https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/ Thu VPC Fundamentals: introduction, firewalls in VPC (SG, NACL), preparation Deploy EC2 in VPC: Subnet → Route Table → Internet Gateway → Security Group → EC2 08/10/2026 08/10/2026 https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/ Fri VPC Networking: Site-to-Site VPN, Infrastructure as Code VPC final lab & cleanup; review Account → Cost → IAM → VPC → EC2 → Security 09/10/2026 09/10/2026 https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/ Expected Week 1 Outcomes: Understand AWS Account, IAM and basic VPC architecture.

title: Worklog
content:
This worklog covers a 12-week AWS learning roadmap (05/10/2026 → 25/12/2026), Monday to Friday, mornings 09:00–12:00 and afternoons 13:30–17:00.
Week 1 (05/10–09/10): AWS Fundamentals, IAM & VPC
Week 2 (12/10–16/10): EC2, IAM Roles, S3 & RDS
Week 3 (19/10–23/10): RDS, Lightsail, Scaling, Monitoring & DNS
Week 4 (26/10–30/10): AWS CLI, DynamoDB, ElastiCache & Networking
Week 5 (02/11–06/11): CloudFront, Edge & High Availability
Week 6 (09/11–13/11): Migration, Lambda & Operations
Week 7 (16/11–20/11): Infrastructure as Code
Week 8 (23/11–27/11): IaC Workshop & Operations
Week 9 (30/11–04/12): AWS Security
Week 10 (07/12–11/12): Security, Reliability & Docker
Week 11 (14/12–18/12): Docker, ECS, ECS/CDK & CI/CD
Week 12 (21/12–25/12): Advanced, Cost Optimization & Final Project
